ambient_events: A planter mists itself and the ornamental basin, uselessly.
A resident hurries through, not looking at the water.
description: A pocket of would-be gentility at the water's edge — planters, a dry ornamental basin, and frontages that face away from the docks as if embarrassed by them. A security checkpoint straddles The Steps here — a scanner arch and a pair of unimpressed guards vetting everyone who climbs up into the government quarter.
name: Vellum Court
